SNAKE WITH ZOMBIES

Begin in a SAFE HUB, enter the dungeon gate, and explore an infinite screen-by-screen roguelike. Zombies drop permanent Souls and parts. Shop purchases and mutations survive death, restart, and new runs. Progress saves locally.

Move: arrows / WASD / on-canvas touch pad / drag on the battlefield. Your snake automatically bites nearby zombies. Tap VENOM as often as you like: zero cooldown. Collect purple upgrade-point drops to buy permanent powers and procedural stock. Cross a doorway to scroll into another dungeon room. Return west from the entrance room to reach the safe hub.

This is an actual playable arcade alpha, not the previous simulation screen.
